content: Ye Yisas wonou yurau eng ye baraitari igoum, end namanimun e gumotoroum. An yamangar wau nob, ye Qenu apand mom wot igub anqenungaroum. Eng ye gari ue, munon qei gor Qenut igub igour eng gor wuri anqenungar igour.
Qob apand qas qamarau eng in qenen qamb igoun. End bo ger me wugunei, qenen ende ininob igama uber igoruboun.
Qenu ininou Tain, ne wonou wau Yisas munon inubersiau tari eng wuri inmusub ne intoubar ne oau mein eng abari inopuri ten igamari in qob apand qas qamb ne qibanamsi igoruboun.
4-11 Yisas qob eng qoregen toat munon qei wurit igau qomon eng init igoriner
Ye igoum eng aninou wau eng Qenu qomon apand eng in toat igorun qamb inimbigor eng toat igour ende qamarari igub mismisir igoum.
End ne an wau unor eng an qebi quraum. In gugum wagari munon qei wuriqenungarun. Qomon eng quraum eng bubun ue, se qamart qanambig qomon eng mom igumin eng ye sabum quraum.
Munon gugum wuri qenungarau qomon eng: in Qenu wonou qomon eng toat obouboun. Qoan qanambig qomon ete igomanei: an munon gugum wuritoubarau qomon eng mom toat igoarar.

Munon irou anmurimarub qamb ai e wurinosi qib igour. Wuri ete at qamb qib igour: “Yisas munon inubersiau tari wo munangit gas ende ag e me darau,” ende qamb igour. Munon yurau eng wuri qetopur tari, wuri Yisas wurinou munon qarau.
An qoyamet igoarar. Song ar igorunon eng an mi uber baub qamb ebet igoumon eng bo me baunanei. End ne imbig igo mi baub at igoumon eng baub qas wagar.

Munon ger munon inubersiau tari qob qamar eng me igetet ne wonou qob qei-qei toat qib igoriner eng, wo Qenu wonou munon banam ue. A Yisas qob qamar eng mom igetet toat igoriner eng, wau ur nob munon eng boopuri ten igorubour.
Munon qei animbogoub qamb yarab Yisas qob eng qamar gas ende me aninob qamarari igub an me wuribanamsiarar. Ne gor qob uber me wurinob qamarar.
Munon ger munon eng gas ende eng banamsieriner eng wonou qomon boru eng wo gor toat ebeiba.
Ye qob irou namanimunt gumat aninob qemeribam. Ego yonou git yarab ne qabarit qemerine igari ne erogori mismisiruboun.
Qenu wonou uyes aninou imemi eng maribigorei. End aninou imemi eng wonou wagrari big anit mismisir uber igoarar qamb qob anit bigour.
